newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee dips on rumours, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee dips on rumours, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.18 rupees down at 40.55 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid rumours that the central bank would devalue the rupee in the next few days, dealers said.
A central bank spokesperson denied the rumours but dealers said speculative buying of dollars would keep the rupee weak.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, was 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 9.25 percent, compared to its previous close at 9.0 percent.
